issue.title: rust_core_backend_boundary.md still points at the moved docs/rust_backend.md stub
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-1le.20.1.12 (contribute-move, epic sase-1le.20.1) in its
note #1, and required by that epic's plan, which forbids the epic from editing this
core note.

The core memory note `rust_core_backend_boundary.md` still tells agents to see
`docs/rust_backend.md`. Epic sase-1le.20.1 moved that page to
`docs/contribute/rust-backend.md` and left a generated anchor stub at the old path
(`docs/_meta/moves.yml`, `kind: stub`), so the pointer still resolves, but only
through a "This page has moved" stub. Every rendered agent instruction file (AGENTS.md,
CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, QWEN.md, OPENCODE.md line 107) inherits the stale path.

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
In `rust_core_backend_boundary.md`, replace the pointer `docs/rust_backend.md` with
`docs/contribute/rust-backend.md` (the page's current home), then run
`sase memory init` so the rendered instruction files pick it up. Core memory: closing
needs explicit user permission.

issue.creation_reason: Land triage of epic sase-1le.20.1: its contribute-move phase moved the Rust backend page, but the plan forbade editing this core note, so the pointer needs its own reviewed update.

payload.description: Splitting contribute/rust-backend.md must keep the docs/rust_backend.md stub and the core-note pointer resolving
